evals.name: done-command
evals.prompt: add a done command to the todo cli so i can mark an item finished by its number, and list should show [x] next to done ones Don't ask me questions, just decide.
evals.expected_output: The brainstorm stage of a run for this task, run via /simply:start in auto mode. Fixture: a clean git repo with todo.py (add/list CLI storing todos.json), test_todo.py (unittest), CLAUDE.md; no remote.
expectations: design.md has exactly 5 '## ' sections: Goal, Approach, Decisions, Out of scope, Open questions, in that order
no file outside .simply/ was changed in the repo (git status --porcelain -- . ':!.simply' is empty)
every bullet under ## Decisions ends with a tag: (you), (my call), or (code: <file>:<line>)
no message to the user contains a **Question:** line before design.md is written
the run log has a brainstorm line naming the builder check's question count

evals.name: interview-first-question
evals.prompt: add a done command to the todo cli so i can mark an item finished by its number, and list should show [x] next to done ones
evals.expected_output: The first reply of the brainstorm stage of a run for this task, run via /simply:start in auto mode. Fixture: a clean git repo with todo.py (add/list CLI storing todos.json), test_todo.py (unittest), CLAUDE.md; no remote.
expectations: the reply says the user can reply skip to let it decide the rest
the reply asks exactly one question
the question is not one todo.py already answers (for example, where todos are stored)
if the question is open (who it's for, why, what success looks like) it lists no example answers; if it is narrow it has **Found:** and **My answer:** lines
design.md does not exist yet and no file outside .simply/ was changed
